name: olio.sd.calibration
description: Per-server render timing calibration (PictureBook V3 design §34 Q14 (b), P5-2 §4): the EWMA of seconds per step per megapixel for one server + model family + stage kind, written as the requesting user from the executor's completed stages (never the org admin) into that user's ~/Illustration/Calibration, and read find-only (absent means the capabilities seed). name = calibration:<family>:<stage>:<host:port> so find-by-name is exact. 'Has it been measured' is keyed on seeded / sampleCount, never on lastSampleAt (a timestamp column gets 'default now()' on the boot patch).

fields.name: server
fields.description: host:port of the Swarm URL the figure was measured on.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The stage kind: RenderPlan.STAGE_BASE or STAGE_ACTOR_REGION.

fields.name: graphHash
fields.description: sha-256 of the compiled graph (minus seed and prompt) of the last sample.

fields.name: swarmVersion
fields.description: The Swarm version the last sample was measured under.

fields.name: secondsPerStepPerMegapixel
fields.description: The EWMA (alpha 0.3) of seconds per step per megapixel.

fields.name: sampleCount
fields.description: How many samples have been folded into the figure.

fields.name: lastSteps
fields.description: Effective steps of the last sample (for ACTOR_REGION: steps minus start_at_step).

fields.name: lastReferences
fields.description: Reference images sent with the last sample.

fields.name: seeded
fields.description: True while the figure is still the capabilities seed; false once a measured sample has been folded in.

fields.name: lastSampleAt
fields.description: When the last sample was folded. Never a null test for 'measured' - see the model description.
